ITEM 1 | Dense pile of small, flat, irregularly lobed dark green leaves with thin pale green stems, covering roughly 60-65% of a white square plate (plate about 26 cm across, so pile about 15-17 cm wide), slightly glossy with a light dressing sheen, piled about 4-5 cm high at center, leaves intact and wilted slightly, scattered among pale stems | 110

ITEM 2 | Small pale off-white to cream chunks, roughly 1-2 cm across, irregular and slightly crumbly, dispersed among the greens near the center and lower left, matte surface with faint tan edges, about 4-5 small pieces covering under 3% of the plate, sitting on and between the leaves | 12

ITEM 3 | Thin glossy translucent film or light coating visible on the leaves, pale golden-green sheen suggesting a light oil or vinaigrette, spread across the leafy pile with no pooling on the white plate surface | 6
